environment.description: AWS Lambda function with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No API Gateway, no CloudFront, no additional authentication layer. Any HTTP client can invoke the function directly. The Lambda execution role has AmazonSQSFullAccess and network access to the RDS instance. No resource policy restricts invocation.
